title: VTA Events — Invitee — Show — payload
description: An invitee reads an event a person invited them to, from the host they were invited by: the event without its access details, their own registration, and the roster where the event's roster setting shows it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTA Events — Invitee — Show — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vta/events/invitee/show/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vta/events/invitee/show/0.1#response.

registration.description: The invitee's own registration, where they hold one.

roster.description: Present only where the roster is `visible` and the invitee is `going` or `maybe`: the other registrations that are (VTI-EVT-053, VTI-PEV-024).
